knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A record of each product by name, batch if available, date and area lets a reaction be traced to the product.
The product is withdrawn for that client, and the reaction is recorded.
The artist refers the client to a health professional and records the referral; the artist gives no medical advice.

practicalCriteria: Assessor reviews a consultation record and confirms it captures allergies, previous reactions and referral needs
Assessor checks a product record traces each product used on a simulated client by name and area
evidenceRequired: Consultation record for a simulated client
Product record for a simulated appointment
stopWorkCriteria: A product is used on a client whose allergy record has not been checked
A reported reaction is not recorded
